    """Compute CIL = I(V; Y | G) in bits using empirical distributions."""
    n = len(v_outputs)
    assert len(ground_truths) == n == len(g_answers)
    
    g_values = set(g_answers)
    cil = 0.0
    for g in g_values:

        v_marginal = Counter()
        y_marginal = Counter()
        for i in mask:

            v_marginal[v_outputs[i]] += 1
            y_marginal[ground_truths[i]] += 1
